items.what: In rust-v0.169.0 (Nov 13, 2026), codex exec keeps project configuration and MCP servers disabled in untrusted directories, even with --sandbox workspace-write.
items.test: If CI runs codex exec in a fresh checkout and relies on project config or MCP servers, run it after upgrading and check they load. The release notes say to use --trust with codex exec or codex review to explicitly save project trust.

items.what: In v2.3.0 (Nov 13, 2026), subagents run in the background by default: they return immediately and report back when idle. Transcript verbosity also now defaults to low.
items.test: If a workflow expects a subagent's result before the next step, run it after upgrading and check the order still holds. To see every tool step again, set session.verbosity to medium or high; an existing setting is kept.

items.what: In v2.1.323 (Nov 12, 2026), plugin.json accepts engines["claude-code"]: plugins outside their stated Claude Code version range are not installed, updated or loaded.
items.test: If you publish a plugin, set an engines["claude-code"] range you have tested and run claude plugin validate; if you install plugins, check after upgrading that the ones you rely on still load.
